description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language categories. The horizontal axis, labeled "family," displays the categories in the following order from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -5 to 35, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30) and corresponding horizontal grid lines. Within each language family category, the data is represented by a group of six adjacent bars, distinguished by color and defined by a legend. The light blue bars represent "mBERT-L₂," the dark blue bars represent "XLM-L₂," the light green bars represent "mBERT-R₂," the dark green bars represent "XLM-R₂," the light pink bars represent "mBERT-B₂," and the dark red bars represent "XLM-B₂." The values vary significantly across the groups; for example, the tallest bar in the chart is the light pink mBERT-B₂ bar in the IE-Indic group, reaching an approximate value of 24, while the lowest value is the light green mBERT-R₂ bar in the Semitic group, which extends downward below the zero line to approximately -2.5. Other groups, such as Isolate and Uralic, feature bars that all remain close to 0. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by value. Visually, every bar in the chart is outlined in black and features a vertical black error bar with capped ends extending above and below the top edge of the bar.
